note: Every ID changes between editions because the edition is part of the ID. 'unchanged' means the published title, origin and canonical text are identical; the hash differs only because the structural ID differs. 'unchanged_edition_token_only' = identical except inline citation IDs re-pointed to the new edition. 'corrected_against_supplied_standard' = compiler-authored claim corrected against the supplied standard (reason and evidence IDs recorded). Position (part/chapter/section) is stable.

corrections.reason: E1 said impact assessment is foreseen 'before deployment'; INSO 42001 6.1.4 / 8.4 print: process required; performed at planned intervals or on significant change.
E1 claimed DIRECT coverage of 'dark patterns'; the printed INSO 23733 text does not contain the concept (searched the verified evidence).
E1 said the cycle is mandatory 'under ISO/IEC 42001 certification'; the supplied INSO text prints no certification statement (searched); only that the standard states requirements.
E1 said both documents describe the options 'reduce, avoid, transfer, accept'; INSO 23733 6.5.2 prints seven different options.
Same over-claim as P04/C34/S08 (bias assessment 'as controls').
E1 said 42001 'controls address fairness and non-discrimination'; the printed text lists fairness only as an example objective in Annexes B/C, not as an Annex A control.
